lead.title: Evotec and Bristol Myers Squibb win a second FDA IND for a CELMoD molecular glue from their alliance
lead.deck: Announced on November 19 by the Hamburg-based company, the FDA clearance covers a cereblon E3 ligase modulator (CELMoD) whose name and indication have not been disclosed; a Phase 1 trial is set to start in 2027, while the alliance's first candidate has been in Phase 1 since March 2026 in advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Formed in 2018 with Celgene and expanded in 2022, the collaboration pairs Evotec's PanOmics and PanHunter platforms and AI with BMS's CELMoD compound library: this second IND validates an 'industrialized' discovery model for molecular glues, from AI-assisted screening to the clinic.

milestone.title: FDA approves Infilbray (venglustat), the first treatment for the neurological symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher disease
milestone.summary: A once-daily, brain-penetrating pill, this glucosylceramide synthase inhibitor is cleared for adults and children weighing at least 15 kg. In the LEAP2MONO trial it significantly improved neurological scores (SARA, RBANS) at 52 weeks versus Cerezyme infusions, while matching them on spleen, liver and hemoglobin.
milestone.why: Enzyme replacement therapies do not reach the brain: a small molecule that does opens a path for the neurological forms of lysosomal diseases. A comparable to keep in proportion — venglustat failed in Parkinson's, Fabry disease and GM2 gangliosidosis, and analysts now see only $300M to $500M in peak annual sales; it remains under review in the EU and Japan.

brefsEurope.title: NuCana shows preclinically that NUC-7738 boosts carfilzomib in multiple myeloma
brefsEurope.summary: Presented as a poster on November 20 at the EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium in Barcelona, the data show the combination cutting cell viability to 3% in two myeloma cell lines (26% in the third), and in a screen of 70 partner drugs across 35 cell lines carfilzomib ranked first. NUC-7738 is in Phase 2 in anti-PD-1-resistant melanoma, with final results due at ESMO IO in London on December 14–16.

brefsEurope.title: FDA clears Novo Nordisk's once-weekly growth hormone Sogroya for children with Turner syndrome
brefsEurope.summary: In the Turner cohort of the Phase 3 REAL8 trial (105 children aged 2.5 to 10), somapacitan delivered annualized height velocity of 8.9 cm per year versus 9.7 cm on daily somatropin. One injection a week instead of seven: a comparable on the value of long-acting formulations against daily biologics.

brefsEurope.title: Angelini Pharma loses chief scientific officer Rafal Kaminski, architect of its epilepsy pipeline
brefsEurope.summary: The CSO leaves the Italian group at the end of November after nearly five years; chief business officer Preethi Sundaram takes over his duties during the search. The departure comes in the middle of integrating US-based Catalyst Pharma, acquired for $4.1B in July.

brefsEurope.title: Nanologica raises about SEK 85.7M for its silica media used to purify insulin and GLP-1-type peptides
brefsEurope.summary: Closed on November 17, the rights issue was 77.55% subscribed after guarantors were called on, including Sterling Pharma Solutions as top guarantor; on November 21 the company paid Bergs Securities' and Ardena's fees in shares to preserve cash. A consumables supplier riding the GLP-1 wave, listed in Stockholm.

brefsIntl.title: Erasca's pan-RAS molecular glue ERAS-0015 posts a 44% response rate in pretreated pancreatic cancer
brefsIntl.summary: In Phase 1 (122 patients after at least two lines), the response rate reached 63% in G12D-mutant and 80% in G12V-mutant patients, with mostly mild side effects and no discontinuations for toxicity; Erasca is preparing a Phase 3. Direct pressure on Revolution Medicines' Rasonque, authorized in the EU this week.

brefsIntl.title: VitriVax raises an $87M Series C to take a single-dose Lyme disease vaccine into the clinic
brefsIntl.summary: The round brings together F-Prime Capital, RA Capital Management, NEA, Eli Lilly and Sanofi's venture arm. The candidate needs no adjuvant, which could cut side effects and production costs; the money funds the first-in-human trial.

word.fr: US filing to enter clinical trials
word.definition: The dossier a biotech files with the FDA to win the right to test its molecule in humans for the first time in the United States: without it, an unapproved drug cannot even be shipped across state lines to trial sites.

parts.label: Pharmacology and toxicology
parts.role: the preclinical data (animal, in vitro) showing the molecule is reasonably safe for a first human trial

parts.label: Manufacturing (CMC)
parts.role: composition, manufacturer, stability and quality controls that guarantee consistent batches

parts.label: Clinical protocols
parts.role: the trial plan, the investigators, and commitments to informed consent and ethics committee (IRB) review

how.t: The biotech runs the regulatory toxicology and manufacturing studies required before any human dosing.
After filing, the sponsor must wait 30 calendar days while the FDA checks that participants will not face unreasonable risk.
Absent an FDA objection, the IND is cleared: Phase 1 can begin, and the file then evolves with the trial's amendments.

word.why: The IND is the first regulatory milestone that turns a preclinical asset into a clinical company: it gates the first patient dosed, and with it the first real read on value, as the Evotec-BMS alliance's second IND is a reminder. For a VC, tracking rounds that explicitly fund 'IND-enabling studies' (Commit Biologics, for example) flags a biotech before its first human data.

startups.name: Complement Therapeutics
startups.use: FDA IND clearance in October 2025 for CTx001, an AAV gene therapy delivering a mini-CR1 receptor in geographic atrophy; first patient dosed in the Phase I/II Opti-GAIN trial in March 2026

startups.name: Commit Biologics
startups.use: $60M seed closed in November 2026 (final close led by Ackermans & van Haaren) to fund IND-enabling studies and the regulatory filing for COM002, a complement engager for non-Hodgkin lymphoma

startups.name: Biolojic Design
startups.use: FDA IND clearance in November 2026 for BD200, an anti-Trop2/Nectin-4 multibody conjugate with a topoisomerase inhibitor payload; global Phase 1 starting in the US
